readerPresentationReview.scope: First-read chapter threads, key-term navigation, progressive disclosure and clearly labelled hypothetical worked examples. This revision adds five polymer-science sections to the beginner materials path and six advanced sections across fibre orientation and high-performance polymers; it also expands the corresponding reader prompts. All content stays within existing governed module claims and evidence.

latestRevision.conclusion: Expanded r03 with five beginner-friendly polymer-science sections on repeat units, molecular-weight distributions, branching and entanglement, thermal transitions, cooling-rate evidence and polymer measurement methods. Expanded r03a with six advanced sections on spatial fibre-orientation fields, micro-CT/model comparison, directional measurement planning, grade/system compatibility, thermal history and supplier-document interpretation. Added three primary/standards evidence records to existing claim scopes; no claim IDs or process recipes were added.
latestRevision.rationale: The beginner path now explains chain populations and molecular architecture, distinguishes glass transition, melting and crystallisation, and teaches what DSC and other measurements can establish. The advanced follow-up is more than twice its prior first-read length and develops evidence planning for both fibre-reinforced parts and demanding material changes. The LDPE, polypropylene and DSC examples are limited to the sources, samples and methods described; they do not establish generic machine settings or product acceptance.
latestRevision.materialChapterEmphasis: r03 now builds from repeat units through molecular-weight distribution, branching, entanglement, thermal transitions, crystallisation and measurement limits before returning to grade identity and part evidence. r03a follows with deeper spatial orientation and material-system review. r18 and r19 retain their existing dimensional-stability and thin-wall/multi-cavity focus.
